title: 第26章
content:
与此同时，盘旋在空中的武装直升机上。亲眼目睹表哥卢克被面前这个该死的特工用阴谋诡计坑害死，罗伯特怒不可遏，疯狂挣扎扑向这个混蛋的同时，用亲切优美的语言问候了他的全家。“呵，印第安小子，再过不久你会后悔自己说过这些话的……”威廉.斯蒂芬无所谓地扫了他一眼，没有跟一个死人计较。在失去了卢克.邓肯这个拥有重大拉拢价值的目标庇护后，他能想到的这对印第安姐弟最好的结局，就是他们双双死于实验室里。毕竟这可是世界上第一个超能力者的亲属。说不定他们体内的血脉有什么特殊之处呢。对上层社会黑暗了若指掌的威廉.斯蒂芬，知道那些大型医药公司不会放过这个研究神秘超凡的机会的。说不定这两姐弟死后，身体各个部位还会被明码标价，分开拍卖。而那时候，他凭借这次抓捕卢克行动中力挽狂澜的巨大功劳，早已是FBI里面重权在握的大人物了。何必跟这种快死了的人计较呢。想到得意处，威廉.斯蒂芬脸上露出了一丝笑容。但很快，被下方异象吸引了注意的他，脸上的笑容变成了惊愕。“见鬼，那是什么东西？！！”他站在直升机舱门边上，语气有些不敢置信地说道。……“博主死了没？”“这么久都没动静，尸体应该已经凉了吧……”在距离美国第一国家银行不远处的商业百货大楼三楼餐厅内。刚才导弹爆炸的冲击波震碎了餐厅所有的玻璃，也把离窗户很近的克里斯掀飞了出去。这让直播间内观众顿时没了乐子可看，在那里无聊地刷起了弹幕。而这时，有一个字体加粗的弹幕在已经黑屏的直播间刷过。“大家快去隔壁罗尼的直播间，他那里距离远，没有受到影响。”“really？？”“？”成千上万人退出克里斯的直播间，涌入了隔壁一个街头搞怪博主的直播间。然后他们就看到了不可思议的景象！！只见在美国第一国家银行所在的位置，仍没有散去的偌大烟尘之中，水盈盈的神秘蓝光逸散而出，在半空中形成了如同海市蜃楼般的蜃景。蜃景中的内容是，在一座高大又神圣的月亮金字塔上，阿兹特克人向他们的神灵献上战俘，举行了一场盛大庄严的祭祀仪式。这和卢克曾经在梦中见过的很像。唯一不同的是，蜃景画面中，当祭祀仪式进入到尾声，由最勇猛的阿兹特克战士上前，用黑曜石匕首刺入战俘胸口，向神灵献上心脏作为祭品时，神真的出现了。轰！！！那一刻原本无风无雨的月亮金字塔上瞬间狂风大作，豆大的雨点噼里啪啦落了下来。而围在月亮金字塔四周的众多阿兹特克人对此不惊反喜，他们一个个虔诚地跪倒在地，大口大口喝着落下的雨水，并且神情狂热地呼喊雨神特拉洛克的名。

“伟大的雨神特拉洛克啊，请接受这颗心脏的馈赠，让它的鲜血化为您的力量，驱散黑夜的阴霾，使太阳永不熄灭。”“伟大的雨神特拉洛克啊，请让这孩子的泪水化作甘霖，浸润干裂的土地，让玉米在您的恩泽下生长……”在众多阿兹特克人的祈祷和期盼狂热的眼神下，如今天一样水盈盈的神秘蓝光从祭祀雨神的青铜柱亮起，在半空中形成了一道被蓝色水流环绕，以至于普通人无法看清真实样貌，但却能感受到浩瀚神威的巨大身影。“嘶嘶…..”这种异常真实的威压不只是在现场的人能感觉到。甚至通过直播观看的网友们也感觉自己此刻心脏有些沉，仿佛被什么东西压着一样，大脑一片空白，看着手机屏幕里出现的巨大神灵虚影，想不出该用什么词语去形容祂，又仿佛什么美好词汇都能用在祂的身上。“卧槽！！！”一位来自华国的网友用简单粗暴的国粹发表了起自己此刻的心情。一位来自西班牙的网友紧接其后。“上帝啊，那群印第安人的神明竟然真的存在？？！”这可能是西方世界绝大多数基督教徒此刻心里面的想法。毕竟圣经里面已经说过了，你要信你的主耶和华，祂是这世间唯一全知全能的神。不管大家信不信这话。从小就听着这话长大的西方人此时看到除了上帝之外的神明显圣，心中的震惊是难以想象的。甚至在这之后几分钟，有无数人登陆了梵蒂冈教廷的官网，又或者拨打了他们官方的电话，想要询问这是怎么回事。但很显然。他们无法从梵蒂冈教廷这里得到答案。因为此时的教皇也很懵逼。他怀疑是不是因为自己是第一位非欧洲出身的教皇，也是第一位出自耶稣会的教皇的原因，梵蒂冈那帮老家伙们故意向他隐瞒了一些重要的事情。不然的话，怎么解释现在出现在美国宾夕法尼亚洲的神迹。而且居然还是印第安人的神！！“啊这？？！”而面对教皇愤怒的诘问，梵蒂冈的几位红衣大主教面面相窥，一时之间竟不知说些什么好。因为他们此时也产生了跟教皇相同的想法。难道是我们上任，甚至上上任故意遗漏了，带着某些秘密进了墓地？？！教皇宫内一时之间有些沉默。而在距离美国第一国家银行几公里的一栋大楼里，刚刚乘坐直升机退到这里的乔治.詹特利见此拍桌而起，神色愤怒异常。“该死，是谁让威廉.斯蒂芬自作主张，想出用这种损人不利己的办法的，他难道不知道这样做只会导致更坏的结果，并且让我们调查组受到上级诘难吗？！！”这几句话乔治.詹特利几乎是吼出来的。而房间里调查组成员一个个低着头，默不作声。“哎……”乔治.詹特利见此无奈叹了口气，颓唐地重新坐回了座椅，目光紧紧盯着屏幕。他有一种强烈的预感。出现在费城上空的神迹，有很大可能源于卢克.邓肯想要从银行保险库拿的东西。……

At the same time, an armed helicopter hovered in the sky.Witnessing his cousin Luke being tricked and killed by the damn agent in front of him, Robert was furious. While struggling wildly and pounced on the bastard, he greeted his whole family in kind and beautiful words."Oh, Indian boy, you will regret saying these words in a short time..." William Stephen glanced at him indifferently, not caring about a dead man.After losing the protection of Luke Duncan, a target with great win-win value, the best ending he could think of for the Indian siblings was that they both died in the laboratory.After all, this is the relative of the world's first superpower.Maybe there is something special about the blood in their bodies.William Stephen, who was well aware of the darkness of the upper class, knew that those large pharmaceutical companies would not let go of this opportunity to study the mysterious and extraordinary.Maybe after the two siblings die, various body parts will be clearly marked and auctioned separately.By that time, he had already become a powerful figure in the FBI by virtue of his huge contribution in turning the tide in the arrest of Luke.Why bother with someone who is about to die?Thinking of the proud place, William Stephen showed a smile on his face.But soon, his attention was attracted by the vision below, and the smile on his face turned into astonishment."What the hell is that?!" He stood at the door of the helicopter and said in disbelief...."Is the blogger dead?" "There has been no movement for so long. The body must have been cold..." In the restaurant on the third floor of the Commercial Department Store not far from the First National Bank of the United States.The shock wave from the missile explosion just now shattered all the glass in the restaurant, and also threw Chris who was very close to the window out.This immediately made the audience in the live broadcast room have no fun to watch, and they started posting barrages out of boredom.At this time, a barrage with bold fonts flashed across the live broadcast room that had a black screen."Everyone, go to Ronnie's live broadcast room next door. He is far away and is not affected." "Really??" "?" Thousands of people exited Chris' live broadcast room and poured into the live broadcast room of a street funny blogger next door.Then they saw an incredible sight!!I saw where the First National Bank of the United States was located. Amidst the huge smoke and dust that had not dispersed, a mysterious blue light filled with water escaped, forming a mirage-like mirage in mid-air.The content of the mirage is that on a tall and sacred pyramid of the moon, the Aztecs presented prisoners of war to their gods and held a grand and solemn sacrificial ceremony.It was very similar to what Luke had seen in his dream.The only difference is that in the mirage scene, when the sacrificial ceremony comes to an end, when the bravest Aztec warriors step forward, stab the prisoner's chest with an obsidian dagger, and offer his heart as a sacrifice to the god, the god really appears.boom!!!At that moment, there was a strong wind on the Moon Pyramid, which was originally windless and rainless, and huge raindrops fell.The many Aztecs surrounding the Pyramid of the Moon were not surprised but overjoyed. They knelt down on the ground devoutly one by one, drank the falling rainwater in large gulps, and called the name of the rain god Tlaloc with enthusiasm.

"Great Rain God Tlaloc, please accept the gift of this heart, let its blood turn into your strength, dispel the haze of the night, so that the sun will never go out." "Great Rain God Tlaloc, please let this child's tears turn into rain, soak the dry land, and let the corn grow under your grace...." Under the fervent eyes of many Aztecs who prayed and expected, the mysterious blue light full of water as it was today lit up from the bronze pillar dedicated to the rain god, forming a huge figure surrounded by blue water in mid-air, so that ordinary people could not see the true appearance clearly, but they could feel the vast divine power."Hiss..." This unusually real pressure was not only felt by those at the scene.Even netizens watching through the live broadcast felt that their hearts were a little heavy at the moment, as if they were being pressed by something, and their brains were blank. Looking at the huge shadow of the god appearing on the mobile phone screen, they could not think of any words to use to describe Him, and it seemed that all beautiful words could be used for Him."F*ck!!!" A netizen from China expressed his feelings at the moment with a simple and crude Chinese quintessence.A netizen from Spain followed closely behind."Oh God, those Indian gods really exist??!" This may be what most Christians in the Western world are thinking at this moment.After all, the Bible has said that you must believe in your Lord Jehovah. He is the only all-knowing and all-powerful God in the world.Whether you believe this or not.Westerners who have grown up hearing these words are unimaginably shocked when they see a god other than God being sanctified.Even within a few minutes of this, countless people logged on to the official website of the Vatican or called their official phone number to ask what was going on.But obviously.They couldn't get an answer from the Vatican.Because the Pope was also confused at this time.He wondered if it was because he was the first non-European pope and the first Jesuit pope that the old guys in the Vatican deliberately hid some important things from him.Otherwise, how can we explain the miracles that are happening in Pennsylvania, USA?And he is actually the god of the Indians!!"Ah this??!" Faced with the Pope's angry questioning, several cardinals in the Vatican looked at each other, and for a moment they didn't know what to say.Because they also had the same idea as the Pope at this time.Could it be that we took office, or even deliberately omitted it when we took office, and took certain secrets into the cemetery??!There was a moment of silence in the Papal Palace.In a building a few kilometers away from the First National Bank of the United States, George Gentry, who had just retreated here by helicopter, slapped the table and stood up, looking extremely angry."Damn it, who allowed William Stephen to make his own decisions and come up with this method of harming others and not benefiting himself? Doesn't he know that doing so will only lead to worse results and make our investigation team be questioned by our superiors?!!" George Gentry almost yelled these words.The members of the investigation team in the room lowered their heads and remained silent."Hey..." George Gentry sighed helplessly when he saw this, and sat back in his seat dejectedly, staring at the screen.He had a strong premonition.The miracle that appeared over Philadelphia was most likely caused by what Luke Duncan wanted to take from the bank vault.…
